name: 12801 · Glens Falls, NY
findings: ZIP 12801 (Glens Falls) has 87 nonprofit organizations. 46 of them (53%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 39 organizations.
Arts and cultural organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (17% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 12801 (Glens Falls) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 12801 (Glens Falls) list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 3.0 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 33 organizations here; 23% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are public events so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
